name: Pablo Alayeto
description:
I got into crypto and the Ethereum ecosystem in 2017, mostly investing in ICOs that went nowhere and then trading NFTs in 2020/21. Before crypto I spent 10 years at a tech startup as Project Manager and a few more freelancing. 
Since 2023 I've been at BuidlGuidl working on Product, building tools and education for Ethereum devs: Scaffold-ETH 2, SpeedRunEthereum and much more.
